extracted.name: Best Ever Cowboy Caviar
extracted.description: The best recipe for cowboy caviar combines pinto beans, black-eyed peas, corn, and bell pepper with a tangy dressing for a flavorsome salad or dip.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
1 (14 ounce) can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
1 (11 ounce) can white shoepeg corn, drained
instruction_lines: Combine olive oil, vegetable oil, cider vinegar, and sugar in a small saucepan; bring to a boil, remove from heat, and cool to room temperature.
Combine pinto beans, black-eyed peas, corn, onion, celery, bell pepper, and cilantro in a large bowl; drizzle cooled vinaigrette over bean mixture and toss to coat.
